_readme: 1. Copy this file:  cp scripts/install.template.json install.json
2. Fill in REQUIRED fields (marked REQUIRED below).
That's it — openclaw installs, onboards, configures your AI provider,
adds channels, installs plugins, and sets up the dev agent automatically.

install._doc: How openclaw is installed. 'pnpm' and 'npm' install the published package globally. 'git' clones and builds from source.
install._version_hint: A dist-tag (latest, next, beta) or exact semver. Use 'main' for the git HEAD build.

onboard._doc: Controls the openclaw onboard wizard. All options here map directly to 'openclaw onboard --non-interactive' flags.
onboard._flow_options: quickstart (sensible defaults, fastest) | manual (full control over every setting)
onboard._skip_skills_hint: Set false to configure skill integrations during onboard.
onboard._skip_search_hint: Set false to configure a web-search provider during onboard.
onboard._skip_health_hint: Set true to skip the post-onboard gateway health probe (useful in headless/CI environments).
onboard._skip_ui_hint: Set false to open the web control UI in a browser after onboard.
onboard._install_daemon_hint: Install openclaw as a system service (systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS) so it starts on boot.

gateway._doc: Gateway server settings. The gateway is the local server that connects OpenClaw to your channels and AI provider.
gateway._port_hint: TCP port the gateway listens on. Default 19000.
gateway._bind_options: loopback (localhost only, most secure) | lan (local network) | auto | tailnet | custom
gateway._token_hint: REQUIRED if auth_mode=token. A random secret string. Leave blank and the script generates one for you. Keep it safe — it is the password to your gateway.

ai_provider._doc: The AI model backend. Pick a provider, set the auth_choice that matches, and fill in api_key.
_auth_choice_options: anthropic            → Anthropic Claude (api_key = your Anthropic key)
gemini-api-key       → Google Gemini (api_key = your Gemini key)
github-copilot       → GitHub Copilot (no api_key needed, OAuth flow)
ollama               → Local Ollama (no api_key needed; set ollama_base_url)
skip                 → Skip AI setup for now
ai_provider._api_key_hint: REQUIRED for most providers. Your API key for the selected provider.
ai_provider._model_hint: Optional. Override the default model. Examples: gpt-4o, claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219, gemini-2.0-flash, mistral-large-latest
ai_provider._ollama_base_url_hint: Only used when auth_choice=ollama. URL of your local Ollama server.
ai_provider._custom_base_url_hint: Only used when auth_choice=custom-api-key. Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API.
ai_provider._custom_provider_id_hint: Only used when auth_choice=custom-api-key. A short id for this provider, e.g. my-llm.
ai_provider._custom_model_id_hint: Only used when auth_choice=custom-api-key. The model name to pass in requests.

channels._doc: Messaging channel connections. Set enabled=true and fill in credentials for each channel you want to use. Channels are added via 'openclaw channels add' after onboarding.

telegram._enabled_hint: Set to true to enable this channel.
telegram._bot_token_hint: REQUIRED. Get from @BotFather on Telegram: /newbot. Looks like 1234567890:ABCdef...
telegram._dm_policy_options: pairing (users must pair first, recommended) | allowlist | open | disabled

discord._bot_token_hint: REQUIRED. From Discord Developer Portal → Your App → Bot → Token.

slack._bot_token_hint: REQUIRED. From Slack App config → OAuth & Permissions → Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...).
slack._app_token_hint: REQUIRED. From Slack App config → Basic Information → App-Level Tokens (xapp-...). Needs connections:write scope.

signal._number_hint: REQUIRED. Phone number linked to Signal, e.g. +12025551234.
signal._http_url_hint: URL of your signal-cli REST API server.

matrix._homeserver_hint: REQUIRED. Your Matrix homeserver URL, e.g. https://matrix.org.
matrix._access_token_hint: REQUIRED. Access token for the bot account.

plugins._doc: Plugins (extensions) to install and enable. 'install' accepts npm package names, local paths, or marketplace names. Installing a plugin also approves it. 'enable' enables already-installed plugins by id.
plugins._enable_hint: Plugin ids to enable (must already be installed). Example: ['discord', 'openai', 'brave']

dev_agent._doc: The AI Dev Agent — polls Jira for tickets, writes code, opens Bitbucket PRs. Set enabled=true to activate.
dev_agent.name: My Dev Agent
dev_agent._poll_interval_hint: How often (ms) to poll Jira. 300000 = 5 minutes.
dev_agent._behavior_md_hint: Optional. Markdown rules injected as the agent's system prompt. Leave blank to use the built-in default.

jira._project_key_hint: Optional. Filter to one project, e.g. PROJ. Leave blank to watch all assigned tickets.

bitbucket._doc: Create an App Password at Bitbucket → Settings → App passwords with: Repositories Read+Write, Pull requests Read+Write.
